thread:
Alex: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last week's cache-evict outage. I'm worried we're leaving too many low-priority actions open and not tracking owners/timelines clearly.
Priya: +1. We should have a tiny timeline template for 24/72/7d actions. I can draft.
Marcus: Also need a single-source action tracker (not multiple sheets). Proposal: 1) action id 2) owner 3) priority 4) ETA 5) status. We can keep it in GH issues or a spreadsheet. Thoughts?
Sofia: For comms: incident thread -> summary + actions posted within 24h, weekly follow-up until closed. Also rotate IC monthly so ownership doesn't always fall on same people. @Alex can we add this to oncall handbook?
Alex: Yes. timeline template draft from Priya please. Also prefer GH issues for auditability. If owner misses ETA -> escalation to eng-manager in 48h.
Priya: Draft here:
```
Action: <short desc>
Owner: @name
Priority: High/Med/Low
ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
Status: Open/In progress/Blocked/Done
Postmortem ref: <link>
```
Marcus: I added a sample sheet + script to auto-remind owners (weekly). Link: https://go.example.com/action-tracker
Sofia: We should tag recurring-patterns team when the same RCA appears 3x in 90d. Maybe set a rule in postmortem template.
Alex: Agreed. Next steps:
- Priya: finalize timeline template by EOD Tue
- Marcus: migrate outstanding actions into GH issues by Fri
- Sofia: propose IC rotation schedule and escalation ladder by next Wed
I'll post a short RFC in #eng-oncall once we have drafts :thumbsup:
